{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
MODEL_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/01ai/Yi-1___5-9B"

LOG="/root/runs/ratekv/yi15_9b_full_pipeline.log"

echo "$(date): Waiting for Yi-1.5-9B download — need $EXPECTED_SHARDS safetensor shards..." >> "$LOG"
while true; do
    COUNT=$(ls "$MODEL_DIR"/model-*.safetensors 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
    if [ "$COUNT" -ge "$EXPECTED_SHARDS" ]; then
        # Double-check: wait 60s and verify no file sizes changed (download truly done)
        SIZES1=$(stat -c '%s' "$MODEL_DIR"/model-*.safetensors 2>/dev/null | sort)
        sleep 60
        SIZES2=$(stat -c '%s' "$MODEL_DIR"/model-*.safetensors 2>/dev/null | sort)
        if [ "$SIZES1" = "$SIZES2" ]; then
            echo "$(date): All $COUNT shards ready and stable." >> "$LOG"
            break
        else
            echo "$(date): $COUNT shards found but sizes still changing, waiting..." >> "$LOG"
        fi
    else
        echo "$(date): $COUNT/$EXPECTED_SHARDS shards ready, waiting..." >> "$LOG"

    sleep 60
done
